calls.statement:
SELECT SUM(fsl.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line AS fsl
INNER JOIN dim_product AS dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_store AS ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
WHERE ds.city = 'Lahti'
  AND dp.subcategory = 'Interior Paint'
  AND fsl.sale_date >= '2026-06-29'
  AND fsl.sale_date <= '2026-08-02'
  AND fsl.staff_purchase_flag = false

  dp.product_name,
  fsl.quantity,
  fsl.staff_purchase_flag,
  COUNT(*) as line_count
